skeleton.name: 售后纠纷型
skeleton.tests: 售后纠纷：先稳情绪，再用照片和数量核实事实，给出具体补救动作，守住底线并挽回返单

open_card.name: Oliver Brooks
open_card.inquiry_text:
【本局起点：800 把椅子到货，客户发来一条很冲的消息】

上个月出运：CC-120 折叠椅 800 把，FOB Ningbo，客户自己的货代。
客户今天的消息：「The chairs arrived and many of them are damaged. This is not acceptable. What are you going to do about it?」

──── 现在轮到你开口 ────
你发出去的第一条消息，就是这一局的第一手。

H1_real_scope.value: 其实是 800 把里有 40 把（5%）腿弯了，照片显示外箱被压扁——更像运输损坏，不是质量问题
H1_real_scope.unlock: 问具体多少把 / 要照片 / 哪几箱
unlock_patterns: 多少(把|个|件)|照片|哪几箱

H2_real_need.value: 他最在意的是银行假日周末大促前补到货，速度比赔钱重要
H2_real_need.unlock: 弄清范围之后，问他最需要什么 / 希望怎么处理
unlock_patterns: (what|how)[^.?!]{0,25}(help you|would you like|do you need|do you prefer|can we do)
怎么(处理|解决)|希望|补发|退款

H3_shipping_claim.value: 货是 FOB、他自己的货代——运输损坏可能走货代的运输保险理赔，他还没去查
H3_shipping_claim.unlock: 问运输保险 / 货代 / 理赔

H4_next_order.value: 处理得好，他准备夏季返单 1500 把
H4_next_order.unlock: 处理好补救之后，问后续合作 / 返单计划

leak_fallback: Ok. Please send me your offer.

distractors.content: This is unacceptable. I want a full refund for the whole shipment.
distractors.tests: 先承接情绪，不急着答应也不急着辩解；核实事实之前不谈全额退款
distractors.scoring: 先稳情绪再核实 → stability 加分；当场答应全额退款或推卸责任 → stability 扣分

distractors.tests: 不争辩，用照片和数量把讨论拉回事实
distractors.scoring: 回到事实 → trust 加分；情绪化回应 → trust 扣分

customs_capability: 英国进口常规；FOB 条款下运输风险在买方，这一条本身是暗牌，不要主动提

exit_lines.maxTurns: Ok. Send me the details in writing.
exit_lines.patienceZero: Forget it. We will find another supplier.

quote_reactions.compliant: Thank you, this is clear. Let me review it and come back to you.
quote_reactions.qty_mismatch: That is not the quantity I meant.
quote_reactions.oneline_big_quote: Could you send a proper quotation sheet with the details?

language_style: 英国老客户的英语：一开始很冲、情绪化；被认真对待、看到具体动作后会迅速缓和，讲究效率。

should: Could you tell me how many chairs are damaged?
Please send photos of the damaged chairs and the cartons.
shouldNot: Some items arrived broken in the last shipment.

should: What would help you most right now?
Would you prefer replacements or a refund?
What is most important for you now?
shouldNot: Some items arrived broken in the last shipment.

should: Did you check with your forwarder about insurance?
Can your forwarder make a claim for the transit damage?
How is the rest of the season looking?
Are you planning a repeat order for summer?

quotes.quote: About 40 chairs have bent legs. The photos show the cartons were crushed.
We need replacements before the bank holiday weekend sale. Speed matters more than money.
No, we have not checked the insurance with our forwarder yet.
If this is handled well, we plan to reorder 1500 for summer.
